about_the_game:
Original music composed for the monster volleyball RPG Beastieball by Wishes Unlimited!

Note: The game is in early access, so the soundtrack purchase includes all tracks in the initial release, plus everything that is added to the game between now and its final release! Stay tuned for news on added tracks joining the album!!

  • All music composed & performed by Lena Raine

  • Vocaloid performance on "VS. The Mythic Dreamers" & "VS. The Hello Freaks" by kuraine

  • Vocals on "Untitled recording from an ancient cassette" by Em Halberstadt

  • Game, Set, Match!" arranged & performed by pluswav:

(in order of appearance)

  • Lena Raine

  • FLOOR BABA

  • surasshu

  • Miles Morkri

  • Maxo

  • (Lena again)

  • Cover art by Tia 'TK' Rohrer

  • Special Thanks & Big Inspirations:

my wife & family, bobbin, greg lobanov, alexis dean-jones, harlow diggs, the whole beastieball team, the pluswav crew, plogue, hirokazu tanaka, yasunori mitsuda, yoko shimomura, nobuo uematsu, jun ishikawa, hirokazu ando, junichi masuda, go ichinose, hitomi sato, toby fox, siIvagunner, metric, ryoji yoshitomi, justice, mort garson, robson jorge, skatune network, giga-p, kenmochi hidefumi, weather report, fake blood, among many others...
